name: [WORLD CUP] Start Your Blue Lock Career!
desc:
⚽🔑 START YOUR BLUE LOCK CAREER!

🎉NEXT CODE AT 20K LIKES!
👍 LIKE the game for FREE CODES!
👥 Join the community for even more FREE CODES!

After receiving a mysterious invitation to join the Blue Lock Project, your journey to become the world’s greatest striker begins...

🎮 Start from the beginning, compete in Blue Lock, and fight your way toward the World Cup!
⚡ Watch your career unfold and make important decisions in real time.
🏆 Rise above your rivals, claim the number-one spot, and become the best in the world!
📈 Develop your skills and raise your Overall from 0 to ???.
🔁 Make the right choices and reach the end—or restart your career and try again!
⚙️ Redeem codes through the Settings menu!

This is a Blue Lock-inspired soccer career-mode game. It is not intended to be a exact one-to-one recreation of the original series.

llm.loop: start soccer career -> make choices and spin for outcomes -> play/simulate matches -> raise Overall -> advance to World Cup or restart
llm.objectives: become the world's best striker and reach the World Cup
llm.progression: Overall rating 0 to ???, career stages, Egocoins, slots
llm.instructions: start from the beginning, compete in Blue Lock, make decisions, develop skills, reach the end or restart
unique: choice-driven career simulator built on anime soccer IP
llm.thumbnails: anime-style Roblox soccer players (Isagi #11) celebrating and powering up in stadiums
llm.complexity_notes: mostly UI-driven career/choice system with simulated matches; little 3D gameplay likely
